griffin_get_current_date.description: Read device clock. Response is exactly 10 bytes: [0x74, status, reserved (4B), unix_time u32le].

griffin_get_dataset_info.description: Dataset (history buffer) info. Request carries a dataset offset byte. Response after the 2-byte header: base_time u32le (unix seconds; all-0xFF = none), dataset_number u8, slot_count u8, session_id u16le, record_count u16le. NOTE: opcode 0x02 collides with the legacy "delete measurements" opcode — on Griffin firmware 0x02 means dataset info.

griffin_read_external_flash_image_versio.description: Read external flash firmware image version. Response is 6 bytes: [0x72, status, major, minor, patch, build]; version string is "major.minor.patch" (0xFF = invalid). Requires G-BLE >= 1.2.1. Capture: firmware reported external image 2.3.1 alongside BLE firmware G-BLE-2.2.3.

griffin_region.description: RF region commands (not exercised in the capture): 0x76 = set region null, 0x77 = set EU, 0x78 = set North America, 0x79 = get region.

griffin_self_check.description: Self check / device info. Response (30 bytes max): [0x6D, status, uptime_u32le, device_type, reserved, msp_version (2B), ...]. device_type: 0=unknown, 1=Wave 2, 2=Wave Plus, 3=Wave Mini. Capture: response byte 6 was 0x01 (WAVE2), uptime ~14 h.

griffin_set_current_date.description: Set device clock to unix time (seconds, little-endian).

griffin_ui_settings.description: Read/write UI settings. Sub-command byte: 0=GET, 1=SET, 2=SET_TO_DEFAULT. GET response after the 2-byte header: humidity upper-yellow u8, upper-red u8, lower-yellow u8, lower-red u8 (%RH), radon yellow/red u16le (Bq/m³), VOC yellow/red u16le (ppb), CO₂ yellow/red u16le (ppm), then a settings byte (lower nibble = light setting, upper nibble = sound setting) and an indicator byte (lower nibble = alive-indicator, upper nibble bit 0 = alarm, bit 1 = B2C). Capture GET returned defaults: radon 100/150, VOC 250/2000, CO₂ 800/1000, humidity 25/30/60/70.

report_measurements.description: Request stored measurement records from a sensor dataset.

format_A.description: Indicate which optional fields to include
format_A.name: flags

manufacturer_data.description: Serial number and status flags in manufacturer data.
Airthings BTSIG manufacturer ID 0x0334. Manufacturer data contains 4-byte serial number at offset 0 and 2-byte flags at offset 4.

format.description: Device serial number (little-endian — all three official Airthings readers decode LE, e.g. wave-reader struct '<HLH')
format.name: serial_number

format.description: Bitfield: bit 0 = error, bit 1 = RTC not set, bit 2 = wait, bit 3 = wave disabled, bit 5 = ring spinning blue, bit 6 = waved in last 5 min, bit 7 = pairing mode, bit 8 = new 5-min data, bit 9 = new 60-min data, bits 10-11 = ring color (0=auto, 1=white, 2=green, 3=yellow, 4=red), bit 12 = hub connected (GriffinScanResultData), bit 15 = POST failed. Capture-validated: a Wave Gen 2 advertised flags 0x0021 (bits 0+5, error + ring spinning blue, seen during device setup).
format.name: flags

device.name: Airthings Wave Family
device.notes:
Family of BLE air quality monitors: Wave (radon), Wave Plus (radon + CO₂ + VOC + pressure), Wave Mini (temp/humidity/mold risk), Wave Gen 2, View Plus (particulate + display), and Hub (gateway). All devices share a common GATT profile architecture (AtGattProfile) with per-model service UUIDs, manufacturer ID 820 (0x0334) in advertisement data, and a standardized ASR/ASRACP protocol for reading sensor data and controlling the device.
DISCOVERY: Scan for service UUIDs in advertisement. Manufacturer data (company ID 820) carries 4-byte serial number followed by 2-byte flags. Device type identified by which service UUID is present in the advertisement itself (ADV_IND incomplete 128-bit service UUID list) — the HCI capture shows the scan response is empty on Wave Gen 2.
COMMUNICATION: Connect to the air sensor service UUID. Sensor data read via two paths: 1. Standard BLE GATT characteristics (temperature 2A6E, humidity 2A6F,
   pressure 2A6D, dew point 2A7B) — read directly or via notify.
2. ASR (Air Sensor Read) characteristic — notifications carry packed
   multi-sensor data records. ASRACP (Access Control Point) used to
   request historical data dumps, configure device settings, set time, etc.
   On newer firmware the ASRACP characteristic multiplexes two command
   sets: the legacy ASRACP opcodes (0x01-0x04, 0xF8/0xF9) and the newer
   "Griffin" direct opcodes (0x02 dataset info, 0x66 UI settings, 0x6D
   self check, 0x72-0x74 clock/flash, 0x76-0x79 region), the latter
   confirmed by HCI capture on Wave Gen 2 firmware G-BLE-2.2.3.

CONFIDENCE: Service/characteristic UUIDs are HIGH — sourced directly from decompiled Java/Kotlin code with explicit per-model UUID tables; Wave Gen 2 ASR/ASRACP/combined UUIDs additionally exercised in capture. Advertisement serial/flags layout is HIGH — capture-verified (serial 2950016244 matches the LE decode; flag bits match the app's WaveScanResultData and legacy DeviceDefines bit tables). Combined sensor-data packet format is HIGH on Wave Gen 2 — 20-byte record captured and decoded against the app's CurrentValuesParser. ASRACP opcode protocol is HIGH — full opcode/format tables extracted and the Griffin subset observed live. Note opcode 0x02 is overloaded: legacy "delete measurements" vs Griffin "dataset info"; the captured firmware answered 0x02 with dataset info. ASR notification record framing is still MEDIUM — format codes and offsets are known from the app but no ASR notification was captured. Security is MEDIUM — ATCommandSetFrame suggests optional PIN/challenge auth but flow not fully decoded; the captured session ran entirely without pairing, bonding, or encryption (no SMP traffic).

credentials.notes: BLE-only for sensor access. Hub variant adds WiFi but config is done via BLE.

factory_reset.effect: Not established. A reset would clear the device's logged sensor history and any ASRACP password, but neither the trigger nor its effect was recovered from the app, and the family spans six models whose buttons differ. Requires hardware testing.

methods.description: Scan for Airthings service UUIDs (manufacturer ID 820), connect, read standard BLE characteristics for live readings, or use ASR/ASRACP for historical data and configuration.

steps.action: Scan for Airthings devices via manufacturer ID 820 in advertisement data.
Identify device type by service UUID in scan response.
Connect and read sensor data via standard BLE characteristics or ASR notifications.

setup.notes: No provisioning required. BLE connection only. Device scan filters per-model service UUID. No pairing or PIN required for sensor reads or for the ASRACP writes observed in the HCI capture (no SMP traffic). An optional password/PIN path may still exist for other operations (ATCommandSetFrame parsing suggests a challenge-response auth path, not exercised in the capture).

rejoin.notes: Unpair from OS Bluetooth settings if bonded, then reconnect.

security.notes: Standard BLE GATT connection — no mandatory bonding or pairing for reading sensor data. HCI capture of a full vendor-app session (airthings_2950_wave_capture.pcapng) shows no SMP traffic at all: combined-data reads, DIS reads, and every ASRACP write (Griffin command set, including clock set and UI settings) ran unauthenticated over an unencrypted link. Whether the legacy ATCommandSetFrame challenge-response path (AT+CHALLENGE, AT+CMD) gates any additional operations remains unconfirmed — it was not exercised in the capture.

characteristics.name: ASR (Air Sensor Read)
characteristics.notes: Notification characteristic. Device pushes sensor data records via this characteristic. Data format uses ASR record framing: [flags byte][sensor count or index byte][record sequence 2 bytes] [optional fields based on flags: base time, time offset, dataset index, sensor status] followed by packed sensor value bytes. Flags indicate which optional fields are present.

report_measurements.description: Request stored measurement records from a sensor dataset.

trigger_sensor_read.description: Force an immediate sensor reading (vendor command 0x07).

ui_command.description: Send UI command to device (vendor command 0x62).

command.description: 1=welcome tune, 2=low battery tune, 3=paired tune, 4=radon alert, 5=red ring breathe, 6=green ring breathe, 7=blue ring breathe, 8=measure ref waveform, 9=yellow ring breathe, 10=white breathe, 11=test RGB LEDs, 12=play selected sound, 13=exercise predefined pattern, 14=exercise with RGB components, 15=spin blue to solid

characteristics.name: ASRACP (Air Sensor Read Access Control Point)
characteristics.notes: Control point for the ASR service. Used to request historical data, configure device, set time, trigger readings, etc. Opcodes (write): 1=report measurements, 2=delete measurements, 3=abort operation, 4=count measurements, 248=vendor setup, 249=vendor readback. Indications: 1=report IA, 2=delete IA, 3=status IB, 4=count IC, 248=vendor status IB, 249=vendor status IW.

characteristics.name: Combined Sensor Data
characteristics.notes: Packed multi-sensor current readings. Format varies by device model.

characteristics.name: ASR (Air Sensor Read)
characteristics.notes: Same ASR protocol as Wave Gen 1. See Wave Gen 1 ASR for frame format.

characteristics.name: ASRACP (Air Sensor Read Access Control Point)
characteristics.notes: Same ASRACP protocol as Wave Gen 1, multiplexed with the newer "Griffin" direct command set on firmware G-BLE >= 1.2.1 (commands below; older firmware wraps the same operations in the 0x71 passthrough envelope). Capture-verified on G-BLE-2.2.3: writes of 0x6D/0x74/0x02/0x66/0x72 each answered by an indication echoing the opcode with a status byte (0x00 = OK).

format.name: reserved
format.notes: Not parsed by the app; 0x01 in capture.

format.name: orientation_wavecount
format.notes: Upper nibble = orientation, lower nibble = wave (gesture) count.

format.name: reserved2
format.notes: Not parsed by the app; 01 00 ff ff in capture.

characteristics.name: Combined Sensor Data
characteristics.notes: Packed 20-byte multi-sensor current readings (format below). Layout from the app's CurrentValuesParser (shared with Wave Plus) and validated byte-for-byte against the capture: humidity 53.5 %, radon 13/11 Bq/m³, 24.16 °C, pressure/CO₂/VOC null (0xFF) on Wave 2, which lacks those sensors. 0xFF (uint8) or 0xFFFF (uint16, either byte 0xFF) marks an absent sensor value.

characteristics.name: ASR (Air Sensor Read)
characteristics.notes: Same ASR protocol as Wave Gen 1.

characteristics.name: ASRACP (Air Sensor Read Access Control Point)
characteristics.notes: Same ASRACP protocol as Wave Gen 1.

characteristics.name: Combined Sensor Data
characteristics.notes: Same packed 20-byte layout as the Wave Gen 2 combined characteristic (see b42e4dcc) — the app parses both with the same CurrentValuesParser, with pressure/CO₂/VOC populated here. APK-derived; the capture only exercised the Wave 2 instance.

characteristics.name: Combined Sensor Data
characteristics.notes: Packed multi-sensor current readings, struct "<2B5HLL": unused, temperature, pressure, humidity, VOC, unused x3 — the packet carries pressure and VOC in addition to temperature/humidity. Confirmed by Airthings/wavemini-reader (CURR_VAL_UUID) and Airthings/airthings-ble (CHAR_UUID_WAVEMINI_DATA).

characteristics.name: ASRACP (Air Sensor Read Access Control Point)
characteristics.notes: Access control point. Confirmed by Airthings/airthings-ble (COMMAND_UUID_WAVE_MINI) and ESPHome (ACCESS_CONTROL_POINT_CHARACTERISTIC_UUID).

services.name: View Plus Air Sensor Service
services.notes: Sibling service: b42e77de-ade7-11e4-89d3-123b93f75cba is the Airthings Hub/Bridge device's primary service UUID. View Plus's own ASR/ASRACP characteristic UUIDs were not extracted from the app; the family shares the ASR/ASRACP profile documented on the Wave and Wave Plus services above, but the View Plus UUIDs are unconfirmed and are deliberately not guessed here.

characteristics.name: WiFi Scan
characteristics.notes: WiFi network scanning and results.

characteristics.name: WiFi Status / Region
characteristics.notes: WiFi connection status and region configuration.

characteristics.name: Connectivity Mode / TX Power
characteristics.notes: Switch between BLE and WiFi connectivity modes.

services.name: Product Provisioning Service
services.notes: WiFi and BLE provisioning for View Plus (Albatross). Handles WiFi scanning, region configuration, Smartlink setup, connectivity mode switching, and firmware bundle version queries.

characteristics.name: Temperature Characteristic
characteristics.notes: Standard BLE temperature. Available on most models (including Wave Mini) as individual characteristic. Sole declaration of this UUID.

characteristics.name: Humidity Characteristic
characteristics.notes: Standard BLE humidity. Available on most models (including Wave Mini). Sole declaration of this UUID.

characteristics.name: Pressure Characteristic
characteristics.notes: Standard BLE pressure (SIG: uint32, 0.1 Pa resolution). Available on Wave Plus. The scale below yields hPa (= mbar) directly: 0.1 Pa = 0.001 hPa. This matches the vendor app, which decodes this characteristic as uint32 LE / 1000 (DeviceDataTypes.pressureInSIFromCurrentCharacteristic).

characteristics.name: Dew Point Characteristic
characteristics.notes: Standard BLE dew point. Available on Wave Plus.

services.name: Environmental Sensing Service
services.notes: Bluetooth SIG standard Environmental Sensing Service (0x181A), the defined owner of the temperature/humidity/pressure/dew-point characteristics below. The service UUID is inferred from the SIG assignment rather than captured; the characteristic UUIDs themselves came from the decompiled app.

characteristics.name: Current Time
characteristics.notes: Device RTC. Write to set device clock.

services.name: Current Time Service
services.notes: Bluetooth SIG standard Current Time Service (0x1805), the defined owner of the Current Time characteristic below. Service UUID inferred from the SIG assignment rather than captured.

characteristics.name: OAD Image Block Request
characteristics.notes: Write firmware image blocks.

characteristics.name: OAD Image Notify
characteristics.notes: Notification channel for OAD status.

characteristics.name: OAD Image Control
characteristics.notes: Control OAD transfer (start, abort, commit).

characteristics.name: OAD Image Count
characteristics.notes: Number of firmware images available.

services.name: TI OAD Firmware Update Service
services.notes: Texas Instruments Over-the-Air Download service for firmware updates. Available on most models.

timing.notes: Device samples sensors every 3600 seconds (1 hour) by default. 5-minute and 60-minute data availability flagged in advertisement. Sensor read via BLE is real-time upon connection + notification enable.

variants.notes: Radon-only monitor. Sensors: radon 24h avg, radon long-term avg, temperature, humidity. Device type code: dTWave=1 in legacy code. Sensor indices: 0=radon24h, 2=longTerm, 3=temp, 4=humidity, 5=status.

Updated Wave with Gen 2 hardware. Different service UUID and ASR/ASRACP characteristic UUIDs. Same sensor suite as Gen 1. ASR: b42e538a, ASRACP: b42e50d8, Combined: b42e4dcc. Serial number prefix 2950 (InstrumentTypePrefix.WAVE_2); BLE firmware is named "G-BLE-x.y.z" (capture: G-BLE-2.2.3-master+0). Capture-verified (airthings_2950_wave_capture.pcapng): b42e4a8e is advertised in ADV_IND, the combined characteristic returns the 20-byte packet documented below, and the ASRACP characteristic accepts the Griffin command set (self check, dataset info, clock, UI settings, external flash version) over write/indicate with no pairing. Self-check response byte 6 = device type 0x01 (WAVE2).

Radon + CO₂ + VOC + temperature + humidity + pressure. Device type code: dTWavePlus=2 in legacy code. ASR: b42e2fc2, ASRACP: b42e2d06, Combined: b42e2a68. Includes dew point characteristic (2A7B) and pressure (2A6D).

Compact temp/humidity/mold risk monitor. No radon. Smallest form factor. Same common GATT profile with ASR/ASRACP. The BLE packet on the combined data characteristic (b42e3b98, struct "<2B5HLL") also carries pressure and VOC, beyond the temp/humidity the marketing description suggests.
Humidifier variant. Referenced in Instrument.Type enum (WAVE_MIST_GEN_1) but no separate GATT profile found in this APK version. May share service UUID with Mini.
Air quality monitor with display. Particulate matter (PM) + radon + CO₂. Uses Albatross GATT profile with product provisioning service b42eb4a6 for WiFi/BLE configuration. Alias: "Albatross" in code.
Gateway/hub device. Bridges sub-devices to cloud. Limited sensor data available directly via BLE.
